title: Local Legends: Katy Trail Ice House
summary: Watch Local Legends: Katy Trail Ice House and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog
body_markdown:
When businesses create places where people can gather, relax, and connect, they become more than restaurants. They become part of the community.


Katy Trail Ice House at Preston Park Village in Plano, Texas is a great example of how a destination-focused concept can build loyal customers through shared experiences and a welcoming atmosphere.


Inspired by the beer garden culture of Austin, Katy Trail Ice House has created a unique outdoor environment where families, friends, and neighbors come together. With a scratch kitchen, seating for more than 1,000 guests, and a tree-lined setting that feels like an oasis amid a busy retail corridor, the restaurant offers an experience that keeps customers coming back.


Community involvement is also central to the brand's success. Through charitable giving, school partnerships, local sponsorships, and community events, Katy Trail Ice House actively supports the people and organizations that support it.


Located within Preston Park Village, the restaurant benefits from strong visibility, accessibility, and a complementary mix of retailers that help create a destination customers can enjoy again and again.


This is what happens when the right tenant meets the right retail environment.


In this video, you'll see:


- How Katy Trail Ice House creates an outdoor experience in an urban environment
- Why community involvement helps build customer loyalty
- The role gathering spaces play in creating memorable customer experiences
- How destination dining contributes to shopping center success
- Why experiential concepts continue to resonate with today's consumers


Why it matters: Businesses like Katy Trail Ice House do more than serve food. They create places where people gather, connect, and build community. Their ability to bring people together strengthens the customer experience, supports neighboring businesses, and helps transform retail centers into community destinations.
